title: Fix dark-mode defects: shadcn-token magazine pages, invisible explore stats and footer logo, white companion widget, muted-on-soft dark contrast, sakura-on-soft migration, hardcoded light classes

spec.problem: 2026-11-22 Kiokoto dark-mode production audit and contrast measurements identified dark-theme defects in apps/web: magazine pages use undefined shadcn tokens (bg-card, text-foreground, bg-primary, text-primary, text-primary-foreground, text-muted-foreground, bg-background, ring-primary, accent-foreground, destructive), explore skeleton shimmer uses invisible black-alpha gradient on dark paper with faint border-ink/6 dividers, BrandFull wordmark 'koto' uses hardcoded text-blue-700 and BrandLogo uses hardcoded #1B2A4A fill, companion surfaces (companion-onboarding.tsx, companion-message.tsx, companion-chat-panel.tsx) use hardcoded white/cream/slate light backgrounds with no dark variants, dark muted/subtle (#94a3b8) on dark *-soft surfaces falls below WCAG AA 4.5 (3.54-4.49), exercises-page-client.tsx retains nested text-sakura children inside its bg-sakura-soft wrong-answer button, 9 files carry hardcoded light slate/gray/white or broken hsl(var(--...)) classes with no dark variants, levels timeline and pricing card borders nearly disappear or glare with ring-indigo-100 in dark, and GoogleLoginButton always passes theme:'outline'.

acceptance.text: AC1: No undefined shadcn color tokens (card, foreground, primary, primary-foreground, muted-foreground, background, accent-foreground, destructive) remain in apps/web/app/[locale]/magazine/**; a regression test enforces it.
AC2: Explore StatChip + ribbon and loading shimmer verified/fixed to theme tokens with dark contrast >= 4.5 (test).
AC3: Footer wordmark uses flipping theme tokens (test).
AC4: Companion widget surfaces use theme tokens; no bg-white/bg-slate-50/cream surface remains in the companion components.
AC5: Dark muted/subtle on every *-soft >= 4.5 by the extended contrast regression test; light pairs unchanged.
AC6: No small-text text-sakura on bg-sakura-soft remains in the 4 listed files.
AC7: The 9 listed files no longer carry unthemed light surfaces (or each exception is justified).
AC8: Levels timeline + pricing borders use theme border tokens readable in dark with light unchanged (test).
AC9: Google button receives filled_black when app theme is dark and outline when light, updating on theme change (test).
AC10: pnpm quality verify passes; WEB-434 CLOSED via the harness; git status shows only intended files (no .build/, no tsbuildinfo).

spec.expected_behavior: Magazine uses only real app tokens (bg-surface, bg-paper, text-ink, text-muted, bg-action/text-white, text-accent, border-border, text-danger); explore loading shimmer has a dark white-alpha variant and ribbon uses border-border/bg-border with >=4.5 dark contrast; BrandFull wordmark uses flipping theme tokens (text-ink + text-brand-accent) and BrandLogo uses var(--color-brand-panel); companion surfaces use app theme tokens with no bg-white/bg-slate-50/cream light surfaces; dark muted and subtle on every *-soft surface measure >=4.5 while light tokens remain unchanged; no small-text text-sakura on bg-sakura-soft remains in the 4 audited files; the 9 audited files use theme tokens for surfaces/text/borders; levels timeline and pricing borders use theme border/border-hover/accent tokens readable in dark while keeping light mode unchanged; GoogleLoginButton passes theme:'filled_black' when dark mode is active and re-renders when theme toggles.
spec.observed_behavior: Magazine renders unthemed cards/chips with broken shadcn tokens and bright-blue bg-accent/60 tags; explore loading shimmer is black-alpha on dark paper (loaded StatChip already uses text-ink/text-muted on from-paper to-surface with >=13.4:1 contrast); BrandFull 'koto' uses hardcoded text-blue-700 (Kio already uses text-ink) and BrandLogo uses #1B2A4A; companion onboarding renders bright cream from-amber-50 to-orange-50 and bg-white, companion-message uses bg-slate-50 and from-amber-50 to-orange-50; dark muted on *-soft measures 3.54-4.49; WEB-433 migrated outer sakura-on-soft elements in the 4 files while exercises-page-client.tsx keeps nested text-sakura inside bg-sakura-soft; 9 audited files have hardcoded light surfaces/text (and share-drawer uses nonexistent hsl(var(--...)) vars); levels timeline uses dim #334155 border/line and undefined --color-navy/--color-blue; pricing uses border-slate-200 and glaring ring-indigo-100; GoogleLoginButton always passes theme:'outline'.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the WEB-434 web-only changes; no API, database, admin, or deployment files were modified.
